### What issue are you seeing?

When I sent a message to Codex, it started working on it, but suddenly its Reconnection attempts were triggered then I got these errors. 
⚠ Falling back from WebSockets to HTTPS transport. unexpected status 503 Service Unavailable: Service Unavailable, url:
  wss://chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex/responses, cf-ray: a20a1b8f6da34850-BOM, auth error: 503, auth error code:
  biscuit_baker_service_me_circuit_open
